question: In each deposited human-cell context and time, what are the donor-paired directions of five prespecified RNA markers under IL-10, IL-10-Fc and the myeloid-selective IL-10R agonist relative to PBS and IL-10?
decision: Describe whether the human donor patterns are consistent, mixed or discordant with the exposed selective-response premise, without treating this different agonist/context as D25K aged-brain replication.
strongest_rival: Bulk composition, activation/time effects, donor heterogeneity, compositional normalization and the RNA/function gap can explain or qualify apparent selectivity.
discriminator: All five fixed markers, every deposited time/condition/donor, four predefined paired contrasts and explicit disagreement/zeros, without cell-based tests or post-result marker selection.
exposure_record: Published Navarro and new human-study directions, sample metadata, full matrix integrity and unique marker identities were exposed before this freeze. No unexposed confirmation; this is a separate contextual description.
biological_unit: Reported donor within each GEO series, matched across treatment within time and PBMC activation condition.
nesting_and_overlap: Three donor labels per series, repeatedly sampled across treatments/time and PBMC activation. D1/D2/D3 labels are never joined across series; six unique people are not claimed.
population_and_selection: All 72 PBMC and 36 T-cell libraries and all deposited times/activation strata; five prespecified uniquely annotated markers. Unknown donor age/sex and selection limit transport.
contrast: IL-10 minus PBS; IL-10-Fc minus PBS; ms-IL10R agonist minus PBS; ms-IL10R agonist minus IL-10, separately by series, condition, time and donor.
endpoint: Raw RNA counts, deposited-matrix CPM, log2(CPM+1), each donor-paired difference, median/range and sign counts. RNA is not secretion or tissue function.
methods: Sum every deposited feature for each column denominator. Transform selected markers by log2(1+1e6*count/sum). Match the explicit within-series donor/time/condition keys; show all pairs and three-donor medians/ranges. No P values or confidence intervals.
missingness_and_exclusions: No sample filtering or exclusion of zero-expression markers. Missing/duplicate sample, donor pair or gene-symbol identity stops the stage; all prespecified contrasts retained.
multiplicity: No inferential discovery family, P values or optimized composite scores. Five markers and all four contrasts are fixed before execution; complete outputs retained.
precision_basis: Three reported donors per series, with no justified target population margin or precision basis. Ranges describe the observed donors, not population uncertainty.
interpretation_limit: Different human peripheral-cell experiment and different engineered agonist, not D25K/aged-brain replication. No age interaction, repair, mediation, universal suppression or cross-series donor identity claim.
stop_rule: Stop on source/qualification mismatch, incomplete within-stratum donor matching, ambiguous marker ID, nonpositive denominator or independent arithmetic disagreement. Retain mixed or unfavorable results.
amendment_reason: The qualified public deposits have explicit donor/library matching and unique fixed-marker rows; owner authorized proceeding with relevant new public data. This context branch leaves all Navarro holds intact.
